signals.usability_note: Residential frontage is visible, though a large purple-leaf tree blocks much of the house and the home is set back from the street.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Small shrubs are planted in a mulched bed near the front steps, but there is no crew or equipment and the bed could easily be homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Split-level home with a paved driveway holding two SUVs and a basketball hoop on the right; the large front tree obscures part of the facade and entry.
